title: Invaris evidence v1alpha5 (portable profile)
description: Portable evidence for run, check, challenge, mutate and campaign. Extends v1alpha2, v1alpha3 and v1alpha4 with engineVersion, mutationMetadata, commandDigests and (campaign) effectiveness, and withholds the root path, executable paths, argument lists, output excerpts and free-text details. The schema checks shape; the Go validator recomputes metadata, reproduction identities, digest relationships and effectiveness.
